picks.title: Altara secures $7M to bridge the data gap that's slowing down physical sciences
picks.why_it_matters: Early-stage deal in vertical AI for physical sciences R&D signals investor appetite for AI infrastructure plays beyond software, targeting the massive legacy data problem in biotech, materials, and manufacturing.

picks.title: Agents can now create Cloudflare accounts, buy domains, and deploy
picks.why_it_matters: Major infrastructure players enabling autonomous AI agents to transact and deploy code represents a platform shift that will spawn a new wave of agentic startups and reshape how software gets built and distributed.

picks.title: New frontier of AI forces Trump's heavy hand
picks.why_it_matters: Incoming federal AI gatekeeping for frontier models could create significant regulatory moats for well-capitalized incumbents while raising compliance costs and timelines for early-stage AI startups.
